title: The WPvivid — Backup, Migration & Staging WordPress plugin before 0.9.137 does not verify that a submitted snapshot…
description: A vulnerability in the WPvivid Backup, Migration & Staging WordPress plugin before version 0.9.137 allows an authenticated administrator to supply arbitrary snapshot identifiers. This flaw enables the attacker to cause the plugin to drop database tables matching the supplied prefix, including core WordPress tables, resulting in destruction of the site's database.
